ruleset.name: Apex Code Style Rules
ruleset.description: Custom rules for Apex code style and formatting

rule.name: SingleArgumentMustBeSingleLine
rule.message: Method calls with 0-1 arguments must be on a single line
rule.description:
Method calls with 0-1 arguments must be formatted on a single line. Unnecessary multi-line formatting for single arguments is not allowed as it reduces readability and wastes vertical space.
This rule does not apply when: - The argument is a List or Map declaration, as these often require multi-line formatting for readability. - Using the builder pattern, where method calls are chained after object construction (e.g., new ClassName().method()). Builder patterns are idiomatically formatted with each method call on its own line.
To customize this rule, edit the $maxArgs variable at the beginning of the XPath expression (default: 1). This sets the maximum number of arguments allowed before multi-line formatting is required.
$maxArgs: Maximum number of arguments allowed before multi-line formatting is required (default: 1)
Version: 1.2.0

property.name: xpath
property.value: let $maxArgs := 1 return //MethodCallExpression[ @InputParametersSize <= $maxArgs and @BeginLine != @EndLine and not(.//NewListLiteralExpression or .//NewMapLiteralExpression) and not(ReferenceExpression[1]/(MethodCallExpression | NewObjectExpression)) ]
